titles.title: Untitled (Blue-Headed Indian Doll)

description: The head and torso of a carved figure, possibly a Katsina tihu, fills much of the composition. The figure has a blue head and wears a red and yellow garment.
imageCaption: Image has not been color proofed to current standards, and its colors may differ from the original work. The Museum will replace it when new photography becomes available.
